For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

At Landis+Gyr, our mission is to accelerate the energy transition through purposeful innovation and
trusted partnership. From edge to enterprise, we connect data, devices, and decisions—giving
utilities the intelligence they need to anticipate change, strengthen resilience, and deliver energy
that is reliable, affordable, and sustainable.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

### Featured Resources

###### News & Events

May 28, 2026

Trilliant Showcases AI-Driven Grid Intelligence at Energy Transition Conference 2026 [Read More][46]

Discover What’s Next in Grid Modernization at TechAdvantage 2026 [Read More][47]

January 28, 2026

Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence at DISTRIBUTECH 2026 [Read More][48]

November 6, 2025

Energy Transition Solutions at Enlit Europe 2025 [Read More][49]

###### Featured Content

###### Connect with Trilliant at Upcoming Events and Conferences

Powering Connections. Innovation happens when great minds come together. Discover the conferences,
forums, and exhibitions we’re part of, and see where we’re heading next and meet our team in person.
Explore Our Events Calendar [Events Calendar][50]

###### Featured Blog

###### Local Innovation, Lasting Impact: Advancing Grid Modernization in Canada

Grid modernization is about more than deploying new technology. It is also an opportunity to
strengthen local economies, build domestic expertise, and create more secure and resilient supply
chains. [Read More][51]

intelligence.

increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

## About Cura

We’re Cura Energy. We are a purpose-led business specialising in smart energy and building solutions
for complex and multi-site estates.

— CURA ENERGY

Since 2011, we have helped many of Britain’s biggest – and most carbon-conscious businesses –
including the UK’s leading retail brands - accelerate the path to Net Zero carbon. We use a
combination of data-driven energy solutions and building technologies to solve climate and energy
transition challenges.
 
We do things differently. We take a strategy first approach to every project. Our start point is to
understand the bigger picture whether it’s your ESG goals or operational and compliance challenges.
We offer nationwide coverage to the most demanding sectors including major retail brands,
healthcare, multi-tenancy workplace, finance and large government estates.
 
Cura is proud to be vendor agnostic. Our technology portfolio includes digital and hardware
solutions from global manufacturers including Trend, Siemens, Priva and many others.

Established in 2011
A market leader for energy savings

Providing value driven ideas and innovation

With you all the way, from concept to completion

“Reducing energy use makes perfect business sense. It saves money, enhances corporate reputation and
helps everyone in the fight against climate change” — Carbon Trust
“UK businesses could save approximately £23 billion per year by making simple changes to use
resources more efficiently” — DEFRA
“It is fact, that companies can save up to 30% on their bills with the implementation of an energy
metering system” — Cura Energy
— Carbon Trust
— DEFRA
— Cura Energy

## Services

We will never just come in, install and then go - that’s never been the Cura Energy way and never
will be.

— OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

We see ourselves as your guardian for energy efficiency and reduction, providing a range of service
packages which can be tailored to meet client requirements.

Our team of experts are based in Kent and have the capability to operate nationwide and across
Europe.

With ongoing advancements in new technology, energy products and the various systems available
within the marketplace we make it our role to be armed with the latest up to date information and be
at the forefront of instigating change.

Our clients can be confident that our experience of different product applications allows us to
tailor project processes, installation programmes, deliver on agreed targets and act as an extension
to your business.

We do evolution every day, what we really aspire to is bringing revolution to our industry and you
our client.

* [
  Building Energy Management Systems ][13]
* [
  Energy Reduction Products ][14]
* [
  Aftercare Designed For You ][15]

and dependable sub-metering and energy data insights.

We oversee complete metering installations and perform in-depth validations of existing systems to
ensure accuracy and reliability. This empowers businesses to make data-driven decisions, establish
baselines, track energy project performance and swiftly identify high-consumption areas.

Meters can also support accurate tenant billing in multi-tenanted properties and provide reliable
data for consumption monitoring across different zones or assets within a building. Our service
drives greater transparency, ensures compliance and improves cost-efficiency in energy management.
It also supports stronger relationships between operators, landlords and tenants while maximising
return on investment for asset owners and managers.

Completing our portfolio of turnkey services is LiveEye, our advanced energy management platform.
LiveEye provides comprehensive insights into your energy usage including consumption rates, sources,
functional use, weather impact, and more.

Cura Energy is a leading system integrator providing a wide range of BeMS packages.

We are proud to be an approved supplier and installer of the following BeMS system houses, Siemens,

Cura Energy is a leading system integrator providing a wide range of BeMS packages.

Priva, RDM and Trend.

Whether your business is local, national or global, we can help keep your workspace energy efficient
through effective design, manufacture, engineering and commissioning, irrespective of project size.
Our solutions are 100% energy focused and tailored to suit your needs, keeping systems easy to
operate, without compromising conditions or the operational performance of your building.

Of course not all BEMS systems need to be created from scratch. We can improve and refurbish
existing ones, integrating them seamlessly and our skilled teams can create a range of energy saving
software for new and existing systems.

We know energy reduction and compliance is a constant challenge as businesses face tougher penalties
for not meeting regulatory commitments.

Aligning ourselves with the best energy reduction products available, we can review your installed
metering and management systems and advise on what additional actions can further reduce energy
consumption.

We have a range of solutions and services to suit with products from lighting and HVAC to renewable
technologies. One of our latest products, developed by Cura Energy is Live eye™ which enables Store
Managers, Energy managers and stakeholders to review gas, electricity and water usage live - in real
time. Live eye™ can relay energy readings to you whilst you are on the go to web enabled devices
such as smartphones or tablets wherever you may be in the workspace.

Contact us to learn more about how our services, technology, products and initiatives can help
reduce your projects energy consumption.

We offer different service level packages for the on-going maintenance of your metering, building
management systems and energy reduction products.

Our structured aftercare service ensures that new or existing systems operate as intended and
continue to operate efficiently whether via a preventative or reactive maintenance visit.

We use the latest web-enabled technology to monitor how systems are operating, quickly identifying
any issues so they can be resolved remotely or on-site, either by Cura engineers or your own
in-house team.

Our Cura Engineers provide national coverage, who are multi skilled to investigate all issues from a
completely holistic approach, providing you with true long term value.

Our Bureau Facility operates 365 days a year with a proactive support helpdesk contactable 24 hours
a day, seven days a week.

Our Energy Monitoring Installation & Validation service delivers an end-to-end solution for precise
and dependable sub-metering and energy data insights.

We oversee complete metering installations and perform in-depth validations of existing systems to
ensure accuracy and reliability. This empowers businesses to make data-driven decisions, establish
baselines, track energy project performance and swiftly identify high-consumption areas.

Meters can also support accurate tenant billing in multi-tenanted properties and provide reliable
data for consumption monitoring across different zones or assets within a building. Our service
drives greater transparency, ensures compliance and improves cost-efficiency in energy management.
It also supports stronger relationships between operators, landlords and tenants while maximising
return on investment for asset owners and managers.

Completing our portfolio of turnkey services is LiveEye, our advanced energy management platform.
LiveEye provides comprehensive insights into your energy usage including consumption rates, sources,
functional use, weather impact, and more.

Cura Energy is a leading system integrator providing a wide range of BeMS packages.

We are proud to be an approved supplier and installer of the following BeMS system houses, Siemens,
Priva, RDM and Trend.

Whether your business is local, national or global, we can help keep your workspace energy efficient
through effective design, manufacture, engineering and commissioning, irrespective of project size.
Our solutions are 100% energy focused and tailored to suit your needs, keeping systems easy to
operate, without compromising conditions or the operational performance of your building.

Of course not all BEMS systems need to be created from scratch. We can improve and refurbish
existing ones, integrating them seamlessly and our skilled teams can create a range of energy saving
software for new and existing systems.

We know energy reduction and compliance is a constant challenge as businesses face tougher penalties
for not meeting regulatory commitments.

Aligning ourselves with the best energy reduction products available, we can review your installed
metering and management systems and advise on what additional actions can further reduce energy
consumption.

We have a range of solutions and services to suit with products from lighting and HVAC to renewable
technologies. One of our latest products, developed by Cura Energy is Live eye™ which enables Store
Managers, Energy managers and stakeholders to review gas, electricity and water usage live - in real
time. Live eye™ can relay energy readings to you whilst you are on the go to web enabled devices
such as smartphones or tablets wherever you may be in the workspace.

Contact us to learn more about how our services, technology, products and initiatives can help
reduce your projects energy consumption.

We offer different service level packages for the on-going maintenance of your metering, building
management systems and energy reduction products.

Our structured aftercare service ensures that new or existing systems operate as intended and
continue to operate efficiently whether via a preventative or reactive maintenance visit.

We use the latest web-enabled technology to monitor how systems are operating, quickly identifying
any issues so they can be resolved remotely or on-site, either by Cura engineers or your own
in-house team.

Our Cura Engineers provide national coverage, who are multi skilled to investigate all issues from a
completely holistic approach, providing you with true long term value.

Our Bureau Facility operates 365 days a year with a proactive support helpdesk contactable 24 hours
a day, seven days a week.

In fact, we have more people working together to support you and your fellow owners than any other
strata company in WA, so you can get guidance whenever you need it. This dynamic approach has
created a resilient business with a healthy culture. We invest in continual training for our staff
and share knowledge across our teams, which means low staff turnover and a highly experienced group
at your service. The result? Consistent, expert support and one of the highest client retention
rates in the industry.

We harness industry-leading technology to make strata management easier for you. Our innovative
tools give your strata community immediate access to information and streamline everyday tasks. From
self-service access to accounts and documents, to community engagement tools and an answer for
virtually every FAQ, our tech solutions put you in control.

### **Customer Portal**

The ESM [**Customer Portal**][43] is an online hub where every owner can quickly and easily access
their strata information – levies, meeting minutes, policies, maintenance requests and more – all in
one place. It provides 24/7 access to important documents and updates when your strata company needs
them, giving you transparency and peace of mind at any time. (No waiting for office hours – your
information is always at your fingertips.)

### **ESM Strata Knowledgebase**

Have a strata question? Our comprehensive [Knowledgebase][44] is a platform with hundreds of answers
to frequently asked questions. It includes straightforward explanations with references to the WA
**Strata Titles Act** and real-world examples. Owners and council members can easily navigate the
ins and outs of strata living and law. This 24/7 resource empowers you with knowledge, helping you
make informed decisions and find quick answers without having to call or email.

ESM Strata is a Perth strata management company built around providing the high-quality service and
support that owners deserve for 40 years. We’ve adopted a dynamic company structure focused on a
strong team culture. This focus has developed great leaders, encouraged continuous
knowledge-sharing, and dramatically reduced staff turnover. What does that mean for you? A stable,
dedicated team that provides better customer service and guidance – and a partner you can count on
for the long run. We’re proud that our client retention is among the highest in the industry, a
reflection of our commitment to going above and beyond for the communities we manage. We also
allocate ongoing professional development for our staff each year, ensuring our strata managers stay
up-to-date and our clients benefit from the most current expertise.

### **Customer Service & Support Team**

ESM’s one-of-a-kind Customer Service & Support Team is a hybrid of strata managers and customer
service specialists. This team is available to answer first-level queries and provide immediate
assistance to owners and residents. By handling day-to-day questions and requests promptly, we
**slash wait times** and free up our strata managers to focus on complex issues and strategic
support for your strata. The result is responsive, friendly help when you reach out, and strata
managers who can devote more attention to managing your property effectively.

### **Council of Owners Evenings**

Serving on a Council of Owners is a big responsibility – and often, volunteers have lots of
questions. We recognise that ongoing education and support for council members is essential. That’s
why ESM hosts regular Council of Owners Evenings. These events are an opportunity for council
members to meet with our team in a relaxed, informal setting to discuss any strata topics or
concerns. Our staff shares updates on important issues and changes in strata legislation, and we
answer questions to help councils navigate their duties confidently. It’s one of the ways we go the
extra mile to support the people at the heart of each strata community.

### **Our Experience: Your Advantage**

With over **40**** years** of experience supporting strata communities in Western Australia, we
bring an unmatched depth of knowledge to the table. Councillors and owners who trust ESM to manage
their strata company can relax knowing we’ve seen it all and handled it all before. We take care of
every detail, drawing on decades of expertise in strata law, building maintenance, and community
management. Our long history means we’re prepared for any challenge, and we use that experience to
your advantage. Plus, our commitment to education ensures you’re always getting the latest and best
advice from our team. We want you to feel confident that your strata’s management is in expert hands
– so you can focus on enjoying the benefits of strata living.

### **Sustainability Focus**

Sustainability is a priority for us – and we believe strata communities can lead the way in making
positive environmental change. Because strata properties operate on a larger scale (with shared
facilities, common areas, and many residents), even small eco-friendly changes can have a big
impact. ESM Strata has a dedicated Sustainability Support Team to help owners and Strata Companies
achieve their building’s sustainability goals. Whether it’s improving energy efficiency, installing
solar panels, reducing waste, or enhancing green spaces, we guide and support sustainable
initiatives for your property. We’re passionate about helping our clients create cleaner, greener
living environments that benefit everyone.

**Exclusive Strata Management (ESM)** is Perth’s largest and most experienced strata management
company. We partner with **strata companies** of all sizes to ensure the smooth and effective

the highest levels of support and communication. When we manage your property, you gain a true

With over 39 years in business, ESM today supports more than **850 strata complexes** across Perth

#### [About Us ][36]
* [More support when you need it][37]
* [Technology You Will Love][38]
* [Service you deserve][39]
* [Supporting the Perth Community since 1986][40]

We know that when it comes to running your strata company, reliable and timely support is critical.
That’s why we offer:
* **More support when you need it:** A [dedicated Customer Service & Support team][41] works
  alongside our strata managers to assist with a variety of strata-related matters, ensuring help is
  always at hand
* **Unparalleled service:** Our modern team structure means multiple strata professionals
  collaborate to support your property, so nothing falls through the cracks and you get superior
  service every time.
* **Industry-leading strata knowledge:** We provide an extensive online [knowledge base][42] with
  hundreds of answers to frequently asked questions (available 24/7) and a dedicated Education &
  Training team that keeps everyone informed about the latest strata laws and best practices.
* **Technology that supports you:** Our **customer portal** gives every owner instant access to
  levies, financial reports, minutes, and more – anytime, anywhere – for total transparency and
  convenience.

In fact, we have more people working together to support you and your fellow owners than any other
strata company in WA, so you can get guidance whenever you need it. This dynamic approach has
created a resilient business with a healthy culture. We invest in continual training for our staff
and share knowledge across our teams, which means low staff turnover and a highly experienced group
at your service. The result? Consistent, expert support and one of the highest client retention
rates in the industry.

We harness industry-leading technology to make strata management easier for you. Our innovative
tools give your strata community immediate access to information and streamline everyday tasks. From
self-service access to accounts and documents, to community engagement tools and an answer for
virtually every FAQ, our tech solutions put you in control.

### **Customer Portal**

The ESM [**Customer Portal**][43] is an online hub where every owner can quickly and easily access
their strata information – levies, meeting minutes, policies, maintenance requests and more – all in
one place. It provides 24/7 access to important documents and updates when your strata company needs
them, giving you transparency and peace of mind at any time. (No waiting for office hours – your
information is always at your fingertips.)

### **ESM Strata Knowledgebase**

Have a strata question? Our comprehensive [Knowledgebase][44] is a platform with hundreds of answers
to frequently asked questions. It includes straightforward explanations with references to the WA
**Strata Titles Act** and real-world examples. Owners and council members can easily navigate the
ins and outs of strata living and law. This 24/7 resource empowers you with knowledge, helping you
make informed decisions and find quick answers without having to call or email.

ESM Strata is a Perth strata management company built around providing the high-quality service and
support that owners deserve for 40 years. We’ve adopted a dynamic company structure focused on a
strong team culture. This focus has developed great leaders, encouraged continuous
knowledge-sharing, and dramatically reduced staff turnover. What does that mean for you? A stable,
dedicated team that provides better customer service and guidance – and a partner you can count on
for the long run. We’re proud that our client retention is among the highest in the industry, a
reflection of our commitment to going above and beyond for the communities we manage. We also
allocate ongoing professional development for our staff each year, ensuring our strata managers stay
up-to-date and our clients benefit from the most current expertise.

### **Customer Service & Support Team**

ESM’s one-of-a-kind Customer Service & Support Team is a hybrid of strata managers and customer
service specialists. This team is available to answer first-level queries and provide immediate
assistance to owners and residents. By handling day-to-day questions and requests promptly, we
**slash wait times** and free up our strata managers to focus on complex issues and strategic
support for your strata. The result is responsive, friendly help when you reach out, and strata
managers who can devote more attention to managing your property effectively.

### **Council of Owners Evenings**

Serving on a Council of Owners is a big responsibility – and often, volunteers have lots of
questions. We recognise that ongoing education and support for council members is essential. That’s
why ESM hosts regular Council of Owners Evenings. These events are an opportunity for council
members to meet with our team in a relaxed, informal setting to discuss any strata topics or
concerns. Our staff shares updates on important issues and changes in strata legislation, and we
answer questions to help councils navigate their duties confidently. It’s one of the ways we go the
extra mile to support the people at the heart of each strata community.

### **Our Experience: Your Advantage**

With over **40**** years** of experience supporting strata communities in Western Australia, we
bring an unmatched depth of knowledge to the table. Councillors and owners who trust ESM to manage
their strata company can relax knowing we’ve seen it all and handled it all before. We take care of
every detail, drawing on decades of expertise in strata law, building maintenance, and community
management. Our long history means we’re prepared for any challenge, and we use that experience to
your advantage. Plus, our commitment to education ensures you’re always getting the latest and best
advice from our team. We want you to feel confident that your strata’s management is in expert hands
– so you can focus on enjoying the benefits of strata living.

### **Sustainability Focus**

Sustainability is a priority for us – and we believe strata communities can lead the way in making
positive environmental change. Because strata properties operate on a larger scale (with shared
facilities, common areas, and many residents), even small eco-friendly changes can have a big
impact. ESM Strata has a dedicated Sustainability Support Team to help owners and Strata Companies
achieve their building’s sustainability goals. Whether it’s improving energy efficiency, installing
solar panels, reducing waste, or enhancing green spaces, we guide and support sustainable
initiatives for your property. We’re passionate about helping our clients create cleaner, greener
living environments that benefit everyone.

###### ABOUT US

## WA’s most trusted partner in delivering Strata Management Services

**Exclusive Strata Management (ESM)** is Perth’s largest and most experienced strata management
company. We partner with **strata companies** of all sizes to ensure the smooth and effective
running of your strata complex. How do we do it? By building genuine alignment and trust with your
Council of Owners, prioritising owner education, living by our co-created values, and committing to
the highest levels of support and communication. When we manage your property, you gain a true
partner dedicated to helping your community thrive.

With over 39 years in business, ESM today supports more than **850 strata complexes** across Perth
and WA – representing over **11,700** individual home owners. Our team of nearly 40 strata
professionals works together to deliver reliable, responsive service for each client. As WA’s most
trusted name in strata management, we invite you to experience the ESM Strata difference for
yourself.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Over the years we have had a great many happy customers. You can imagine that on our way there, we
had many of them ask questions. There are many potentially confusing aspects to this service. That
is why we have compiled a list of some of our most commonly asked questions.

What is submetering?

**Utility submetering is the new standard for utility management on properties with multiple
tenants, whether residential or commercial.** In the past, one bill for a utility would be sent to a
property’s landlord. That individual would then have the difficult task of dividing out the bill
based on square footage, or on a more complex algorithm, then divvying out bills, collecting them
and paying the company themselves. What an enormous amount of manual work!

The old method led to an unfair distribution of costs and was a time consuming, tedious, and
extremely inefficient process for the property manager. Today, submetering offers streamlined and
simple solutions to all the manual roles landlords once paid, offering the ability to monitor the
individual utility use of each tenant, and even providing direct billing for that use in appropriate
cases. Submetering is now nationally recognized as a superior means of measuring energy consumption
in a multi-use facility, and in some states, it is even legally required in commercial use
properties.

Why is submetering beneficial?

Managing the utilities for a property is only one of the many roles a landlord must perform,
however, it can take a disproportionate amount of time and energy if the proper equipment and
services have not been put into place. For landlords or owners who are responsible for multiple
properties, the cost and time required to handle utilities at multiple sites can be enormous. Having
one single provider for submetering installation, maintenance and reading can simplify the process
immensely, leaving time for the many other hats a property owner must wear.

**The New York State Energy Research and Authority performed a study on submetering, revealing that
on average, 15 – 30 percent energy use savings can be achieved through the addition of submetering
systems. This savings benefits everyone – the landlord, who has been responsible for distributing
and collecting the payments from every tenant (and dealing with deficits from late payments or
objections from specific tenants), the tenant, who has potentially been paying than more fair share,
and the planet.** When energy use goes down, the planet benefits, too! That’s why in part
submetering is legally required in some states for large commercial properties.

Will submetering save me money?

**Yes! Submetering saves an average of 15 – 30 percent in energy consumption, a savings that is
passed on to the landlord in time.** While there is an upfront investment required to install
submetering equipment, it has one of the fastest turnaround times in terms of return on investment
among other energy savings upgrades or installations. And having clients held individually
responsible for their energy use saves time too, another savings that is passed on to the property
owner.

Submeters save more money and provide a higher return on investment among many other energy savings
investments. Three years is the typical turnaround time to provide a return on an energy savings
property upgrade. Submetering consistently provides a positive ROI in less than three years, and it
will save you for years to come. The cost of submetering units are becoming more and more
competitive as technology advances and as more retailers offer affordable units. This is a great
time to transition to a new way of measuring, reporting and charging your tenants for the utilities
they consume each day.

Will my tenants be upset by submetering?

**No, we find that once tenants are educated about the benefits of submetering, they appreciate the
opportunity to save money themselves. Once submetering systems have been put in place, tenants have
the opportunity to control their own energy usage and in doing so, control how much they must pay.
Tenants welcome the opportunity to pay their fair share, especially when they have the opportunity
to lower their utility bills.**

Here’s an example:

Imagine Apartment 201 is a one bedroom that houses a couple with no children where both spouses work
and are away from the home each day. They turn their air conditioning up to 80 for 8+ hours a day
and work hard to make sure they use as little energy as possible. Apartment 102 on the floor below
houses a family with two parents and five children. Three of the children are home all day, thus the
electricity is on, and the television and lights are constantly in use year round.

Before, the energy bills sent to each family were broken based on the number of bedrooms in the
apartment. Now they will reflect actual usage!

The larger family in 102 may see a bill at a similar amount or perhaps slightly higher. They decide
to make adjustments to their air conditioning use to compensate for the slightly higher bill. When
the next bill comes, they are thrilled that they’ve been able to reduce their bill. The smaller
family in 201 will see a significantly reduced bill, and will be happy to know their efforts at
energy savings are now being rewarded.

[Find Equity] **Find Equity**

Find out where the most water, gas, and energy is being used.

[Save Money] **Save Money**

Figure out which units or components are using the most.

[Impartial Billing] **Impartial Billing**

Let each tennants paying for their portion... fairly.

[Electric] **Electric**

Figure out where the enrgy spikes are in your usage.

[Water] **Water**

Not sure where you are losing water? Find out for sure.

[Natural Gas] **Natural Gas**

Want to ensure everyone is paying for what they use?

[Happy Young Woman Saves Money in Piggy bank]

### Frequently Asked Questions

Over the years we have had a great many happy customers. You can imagine that on our way there, we
had many of them ask questions. There are many potentially confusing aspects to this service. That
is why we have compiled a list of some of our most commonly asked questions.

What is submetering?

**Utility submetering is the new standard for utility management on properties with multiple
tenants, whether residential or commercial.** In the past, one bill for a utility would be sent to a
property’s landlord. That individual would then have the difficult task of dividing out the bill
based on square footage, or on a more complex algorithm, then divvying out bills, collecting them
and paying the company themselves. What an enormous amount of manual work!

The old method led to an unfair distribution of costs and was a time consuming, tedious, and
extremely inefficient process for the property manager. Today, submetering offers streamlined and
simple solutions to all the manual roles landlords once paid, offering the ability to monitor the
individual utility use of each tenant, and even providing direct billing for that use in appropriate
cases. Submetering is now nationally recognized as a superior means of measuring energy consumption
in a multi-use facility, and in some states, it is even legally required in commercial use
properties.

Why is submetering beneficial?

Managing the utilities for a property is only one of the many roles a landlord must perform,
however, it can take a disproportionate amount of time and energy if the proper equipment and
services have not been put into place. For landlords or owners who are responsible for multiple
properties, the cost and time required to handle utilities at multiple sites can be enormous. Having
one single provider for submetering installation, maintenance and reading can simplify the process
immensely, leaving time for the many other hats a property owner must wear.

**The New York State Energy Research and Authority performed a study on submetering, revealing that
on average, 15 – 30 percent energy use savings can be achieved through the addition of submetering
systems. This savings benefits everyone – the landlord, who has been responsible for distributing
and collecting the payments from every tenant (and dealing with deficits from late payments or
objections from specific tenants), the tenant, who has potentially been paying than more fair share,
and the planet.** When energy use goes down, the planet benefits, too! That’s why in part
submetering is legally required in some states for large commercial properties.

Will submetering save me money?

**Yes! Submetering saves an average of 15 – 30 percent in energy consumption, a savings that is
passed on to the landlord in time.** While there is an upfront investment required to install
submetering equipment, it has one of the fastest turnaround times in terms of return on investment
among other energy savings upgrades or installations. And having clients held individually
responsible for their energy use saves time too, another savings that is passed on to the property
owner.

Submeters save more money and provide a higher return on investment among many other energy savings
investments. Three years is the typical turnaround time to provide a return on an energy savings
property upgrade. Submetering consistently provides a positive ROI in less than three years, and it
will save you for years to come. The cost of submetering units are becoming more and more
competitive as technology advances and as more retailers offer affordable units. This is a great
time to transition to a new way of measuring, reporting and charging your tenants for the utilities
they consume each day.

Will my tenants be upset by submetering?

**No, we find that once tenants are educated about the benefits of submetering, they appreciate the
opportunity to save money themselves. Once submetering systems have been put in place, tenants have
the opportunity to control their own energy usage and in doing so, control how much they must pay.
Tenants welcome the opportunity to pay their fair share, especially when they have the opportunity
to lower their utility bills.**

Here’s an example:

Imagine Apartment 201 is a one bedroom that houses a couple with no children where both spouses work
and are away from the home each day. They turn their air conditioning up to 80 for 8+ hours a day
and work hard to make sure they use as little energy as possible. Apartment 102 on the floor below
houses a family with two parents and five children. Three of the children are home all day, thus the
electricity is on, and the television and lights are constantly in use year round.

Before, the energy bills sent to each family were broken based on the number of bedrooms in the
apartment. Now they will reflect actual usage!

The larger family in 102 may see a bill at a similar amount or perhaps slightly higher. They decide
to make adjustments to their air conditioning use to compensate for the slightly higher bill. When
the next bill comes, they are thrilled that they’ve been able to reduce their bill. The smaller
family in 201 will see a significantly reduced bill, and will be happy to know their efforts at
energy savings are now being rewarded.

[ View More Answers][30]

###### We are happy to answer any questions you may have!

[Colorful Row]

Take control of your water, gas, and electric bills with submetering. Whether you want to see who’s
using the most utilities, split bills fairly across units, or find out where your business is losing
money—our expert installation services can help you track usage and cut costs.

Frontline Energy is an energy management solution provider that was founded in 2011 with a goal to
provide an end-to-end maintenance and energy management solution for the built environment. We
design tailored solutions that focus on enhancing business performance and reducing running costs
for our customers. We understand the importance of energy and take it as our responsibility to
advise on ways to minimize energy use, costs, and environmental impact.

[Frontline Energy workers]
[Grey dots]

### Energy Innovation

We implement and service energy solutions and technologies that reduce carbon emissions and improve
cost efficiencies, enhancing the business of our customers and the lives of end users.

#### Cost-efficiency

Cleaner, more efficient means of powering and heating residential and commercial buildings will help
to reduce consumer energy bills and the costs associated with disposing the waste created from its
generation.

#### Climate Change

Identifying new energy technologies or improving efficiencies of current heating solutions will help
reduce the level of carbon emissions into the environment that lead to climate change.

#### Reduced Air Pollution

Finding energy alternatives to fossil fuels to heat and power our homes and businesses will lower
emissions of harmful gases like carbon dioxide.

#### Reliability

With global energy requirements increasing, energy innovation is concerned with identifying means of
energy production that are reliable and dependable enough to meet the needs of a growing population,
and which are cleaner to generate and store.

### Energy/Carbon Reduction

Frontline Energy is an energy management solution provider that was founded in 2011 with a goal to
provide an end-to-end maintenance and energy management solution for the built environment. We
design tailored solutions that focus on enhancing business performance and reducing running costs
for our customers. We understand the importance of energy and take it as our responsibility to
advise on ways to minimize energy use, costs, and environmental impact.

[Learn More][40]
[Frontline Energy workers]
[Grey dots]

### Energy Innovation

We implement and service energy solutions and technologies that reduce carbon emissions and improve
cost efficiencies, enhancing the business of our customers and the lives of end users.

#### Cost-efficiency

Cleaner, more efficient means of powering and heating residential and commercial buildings will help
to reduce consumer energy bills and the costs associated with disposing the waste created from its
generation.

#### Climate Change

Identifying new energy technologies or improving efficiencies of current heating solutions will help
reduce the level of carbon emissions into the environment that lead to climate change.

#### Reduced Air Pollution

Finding energy alternatives to fossil fuels to heat and power our homes and businesses will lower
emissions of harmful gases like carbon dioxide.

#### Reliability

With global energy requirements increasing, energy innovation is concerned with identifying means of
energy production that are reliable and dependable enough to meet the needs of a growing population,
and which are cleaner to generate and store.

[Find out more about our Sustainability Plan][41]

Peter Zambra
COO

Peter has 20 years experience in the facilities/mechanical industry and gained qualifications as a

working closely with the service desk team and technical teams. Peter adopts a hands-on approach
while liaising directly with clients and the operations team to ensure our client's needs and
services are delivered to the highest possible standard.

Denise Coyne
CFO

Denise joined Frontline Energy in 2012 and brings a unique knowledge of supply chain procurement,
and avails of the best commodity prices. Her forecasting ability benefits Frontline's property
manager and investor clients every day. Denise ensures cash flows steadily and reliably so that
continuity of service is maintained for all clients. Denise also has responsibility for all
reporting, financial management and compliance with all financial requirements for the company and
is a Fellow of the Chartered Accountants of Ireland.

Denise Heneghan
Account Manager

Denise has been a key member of the Frontline team since 2010. In her role she assists property
managers and investors to mobilise the district energy contract from the ground up and remove
headaches for Frontline's clients. She has highly developed organisational and communication skills
and provides an important interface between client team and Frontline's technical team in the
operation and maintenance of the district heating system.

Accounts Administrator

With 40 years of experience in accounts and customer service, Caroline is often the first point of
contact for customers at Frontline. She expertly handles all residential account queries, ensuring

to swiftly address concerns, putting customers' minds at ease from the very first interaction. Her
dedication to delivering exceptional service makes her an invaluable asset to our team and a
reassuring presence for our clients.

## A History of Submetering Success

Founded in 1983, Guardian is a leading provider of comprehensive utility cost recovery services. We
specialize in submeter system design, installation, data acquisition, utility billing, collections,
and overall utility management. With nearly four decades of experience, we are committed to
delivering exceptional customer service and reliable solutions across a wide range of properties,
including apartments, condominiums, offices, retail spaces, manufactured housing, and marinas.

advanced submetering technologies. Backed by an in-house team of expert programmers and application
engineers, Guardian works closely with clients to enhance net operating income, increase property
value, and promote sustainability through water and energy conservation.

How it Works

## How Submetering Works

[iStock-629248388.jpg]

### Install

###### A wireless meter is installed for each unit, and a central submeter data collector (about the
###### size of a router) is placed in a mechanical room, closet, or leasing office. For flexibility,
###### pre-programmed, client-installed submeter kits are also available. This setup ensures
###### accurate tracking of individual unit usage.
######  

[moeny_edited.png]

1

### Connect

###### The central data collector connects to the Guardian network using an internet connection
###### provided by the property. For smaller properties that lack a leasing office or clubhouse, we
###### offer 3G and manual read options. Meter readings are sent in real-time, ensuring your
###### property is always up to date on usage data.
###### 
######  

[Wireless Water Submetering]

2

### Bill

###### Each resident receives a monthly utility bill based on their individual submetered usage,
###### charged at the same rates used by the local utility provider. We offer regulatory support to
###### ensure your property’s billing program complies with local rules and regulations, so you stay
###### compliant without hassle.
######  

[invoice_edited.png]

3

### Collect

###### You can choose to manage collections in-house or outsource to Guardian. Our website portal
###### makes it easy to track utility payments, monitor for leaks or usage spikes, and receive
###### notifications. It also integrates with property management software like Yardi, OneSite,
###### AppFolio, Entrata and RentManager.

[HiRes_clipped_rev_1 (1)_edited.png]

4

> Previously, I had been paying all water, sewer and garbage bill for the units. Since the units
> were not individually metered, I had no way of knowing how much each tenant was using.
>  Immediately after installation, the resident billing services began.   I still pay the master
> bill to Seattle Public Utility, but my residents send me their portion of the utility usage based
> on the submetering.  Within four months the system has paid for itself."

Bainbridge Island, Washington

###### accurate tracking of individual unit usage.

[moeny_edited.png]

1

### Connect

###### The central data collector connects to the Guardian network using an internet connection
###### provided by the property. For smaller properties that lack a leasing office or clubhouse, we
###### offer 3G and manual read options. Meter readings are sent in real-time, ensuring your
###### property is always up to date on usage data.
###### 
######  

[Wireless Water Submetering]

2

### Bill

###### Each resident receives a monthly utility bill based on their individual submetered usage,
###### charged at the same rates used by the local utility provider. We offer regulatory support to
###### ensure your property’s billing program complies with local rules and regulations, so you stay
###### compliant without hassle.

###### makes it easy to track utility payments, monitor for leaks or usage spikes, and receive
###### notifications. It also integrates with property management software like Yardi, OneSite,

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

### Many tenants but just one network connection?

Installing a new connection to the electricity network (called an MPAN) typically costs £000s.


But so does renting with “bills included”. 


Our sub-metering system can provide you with a virtual MPAN from £95 - eliminating the need to chase
tenants for the money, sell pre-payment cards or have the inconvenience of collecting and banking
pound coins.


## Based on the latest smart metering technology, it more or less runs itself and offers significant
## advantage over any other system on the market.

[Paypoint sub meter]
[Electric sub meters]
[Electric sub meters]

### Easiest Top-ups

### Internet, Phone and Paypoint

Your tenants do not need to leave their home to top-up or enter long codes. Top-ups can be made
at [www.pay4energy.com][8], or dialling our top-up line, or pay in cash at their local store with a
Paypoint terminal. 

The top-ups are normally delivered automatically to their phone within seconds.

We are currently testing the functionality to allow your tenants to even set up an auto recharge for
their meters when their balance goes low.

### Robust Solution

### Backup token codes

Each of our meters communicates with us through a built in 4G SIM card which is an extremely
reliable means of communication.

However, very occasionally there may be outages in the mobile phone network.  In this case, unlike
our competitors we automatically detect a delay and send out a manual token code.  This code can be
entered directly into the meter through either the integrated or remote keypad.   So your tenants
can be sure to get the top-up that they have paid for. 

[landlord metering]

### Fully Transparent Pricing

### Transparent Pricing

### 15% Margin, no daily charges or hidden fees

We recognise our social responsibilities as much of our client base are socially disadvantaged, so
we aim only to make a modest profit.  We do not charge a daily standing charge - instead we take 15%
of the payments that we collect from your tenants to cover our costs.


Unit rates are set so that you will fully cover the cost of your electricity bills.


We don't charge a standing charge which greatly simplifies and reduces the costs of vacant periods
between tenancies.  But unlike some of our competitors, our meters can accurately bill for day /
night / weekend tariffs and recover the landlord's standing charges. 

### Pay4Energy 

### developed from a ground-up following years of experience

We have developed our own in house sub-metering system which we designed from scratch after eight
years of running a third party's smart metering system. Although the previous system was good, this
addresses the areas where we felt that it, and our competitors' systems could be improved.  We are
proud of our new system and are confident that it is the best on the market. 

Our Pay4Energy system is based on smart sub-meters which we individually  test and pre-configure
before dispatch.

[Electric sub meters]

So as long as each rental unit has its own consumer unit, your electrician can wire in the meter and
it will work immediately.

### For Domestic and Commercial Sites - Large and Small

[Electric sub meters]
[Electric sub meters]
[Electric sub meters]

We have successfully installed our electric sub meters on over 500 sites – including HMOs, flat
conversions, permitted development conversions of offices into residential units, industrial parks
and office blocks.


On some industrial parks we may even be able to take over the responsibility for paying the
electricity supplier directly (fees apply).

### 3000+
### Virtual MPANs created

### Property and utility expertise

Our founder, Gary Wernick, has many years of experience in the energy market as well as being a
landlord and property developer. He has gathered together a professional team to deliver the
metering service that will meet your needs with the first rate customer service that you deserve.

# ELECTRIC SUB METERS FOR LANDLORDS AND TENANTS

#### An efficient way for UK Landlords to manage electricity usage and collect payments from
#### tenants. For LANDLORDS with sub meters, our Help Desk is available 24/7 to assist and advise
#### you. WHOLESALERS can purchase their electric sub meters from us today!


## BUY a sub meter

Metro Prepaid sub meters for landlord electricity are available from leading UK electrical
wholesalers.
Metro Prepaid electric sub meters are suitable for a range of residential and commercial Landlords
who need to recover electricity usage from tenants. Metro Prepaid electric sub-meters are tamper
–resistant, surge resistant, reliable, EU compliant and manufactured for many years of useful life. 

[ Products ][26]


## Install a sub meter

Landlords use their own appointed electrician to install the electric sub meters.
Landlords may install as many electric sub meters per property as the main supply permits.
Electricians must comply with IET wiring codes. The prepayment sub meters are quick to install and
easy to operate.

[ Installation Instructions ][27]


## Using a sub meter

Once installed tenants top up their prepayment meters by [purchasing Metro Codes][28] vended by
Metro Prepaid across thousands of stores in the UK.
Metro Prepaid accumulates these electricity (Metro Code) payments for any given month, and transfers
these funds to the registered Landlord in the first week of the following month. The Landlord uses
the funds to service the cost of the main supply (from its Energy Provider)

[ Buy now ][29]


## Register a sub meter

Registering an electric sub meter is simple.
Basic registration can be done in a few minutes by completing the on-line form below, or
telephonically with our 24/7 Help Desk. All registrations are confirmed telephonically, when our
consultants will also request the Landlord’s bank details, into which Metro Prepaid will make its
monthly payments.

[ Register Meter ][30]


## How to buy Metro codes

Tenants may top-up their prepayment sub meters by purchasing a power code. Power codes are vended by
Metro Prepaid in thousands of high street stores in the UK via PaypPoint, as well as on-line, or via
bank payment, cash deposit or credit card (Paypal). A power code is a 20-digit encrypted number that
is punched into the meter by the tenant on returning home.

[ Buy Online ][31]

## Our Customer Stories

“ After setting up well over 1000 HMO rooms and many years as a property trainer, I know that the
all-in model with free electricity that many HMO owners adopt is flawed. It drives the wrong
behaviour, with tenants not switching off appliances using electric heaters whilst leaving the
windows wide open or worse taking a long weekend in Greece and leaving the appliances running. Savvy
landlords have been sub metering their tenants for years. ”
[READ MORE...][32]

Jim Haliburton - HMO Daddy

## Our Customer Stories

“ We recently spoke regarding our EV installation at 51, Haven Road, Poole. Since we spoke I have
had reason to speak to your help desk on several occasions seeking information. I wish to tell you
that each and every one of your staff that I have dealt with during these calls have had a total
understanding of the product, answered all of my questions, were efficient, helpful and are a total
credit to your company. It is a long time since I have received such excellent customer service. ”

Edward Fuller

## Customer service like customer service should be

“ I rang up a couple of weeks ago and spoke with Faseegah. Had some trouble with purchasing a
voucher and she was fantastic. Extremely helpful and clear in resolving the issue at hand with
minimum fuss. It is my first time using metro electric and I can safely say it’s been a breeze.
Definitely recommend to anyone interested in using metro. Faseegah of course is a huge asset to your
customer service team. Thank you for your prompt assistance. ”

Mr A Khan

## Metro Prepaid Helped Me

“ Joseph Rebutla, answered the 24 help line in less than ten seconds, was so calm thoughtful helpful

# ELECTRIC SUB METERS FOR LANDLORDS AND TENANTS

#### An efficient way for UK Landlords to manage electricity usage and collect payments from
#### tenants. For LANDLORDS with sub meters, our Help Desk is available 24/7 to assist and advise
#### you. WHOLESALERS can purchase their electric sub meters from us today!


## BUY a sub meter

Metro Prepaid sub meters for landlord electricity are available from leading UK electrical
wholesalers.
Metro Prepaid electric sub meters are suitable for a range of residential and commercial Landlords
who need to recover electricity usage from tenants. Metro Prepaid electric sub-meters are tamper
–resistant, surge resistant, reliable, EU compliant and manufactured for many years of useful life. 

[ Products ][26]


## Install a sub meter

Landlords use their own appointed electrician to install the electric sub meters.
Landlords may install as many electric sub meters per property as the main supply permits.
Electricians must comply with IET wiring codes. The prepayment sub meters are quick to install and
easy to operate.

[ Installation Instructions ][27]


## Using a sub meter

Once installed tenants top up their prepayment meters by [purchasing Metro Codes][28] vended by
Metro Prepaid across thousands of stores in the UK.
Metro Prepaid accumulates these electricity (Metro Code) payments for any given month, and transfers
these funds to the registered Landlord in the first week of the following month. The Landlord uses
the funds to service the cost of the main supply (from its Energy Provider)

[ Buy now ][29]


## Register a sub meter

Registering an electric sub meter is simple.
Basic registration can be done in a few minutes by completing the on-line form below, or
telephonically with our 24/7 Help Desk. All registrations are confirmed telephonically, when our
consultants will also request the Landlord’s bank details, into which Metro Prepaid will make its
monthly payments.

[ Register Meter ][30]


## How to buy Metro codes

Tenants may top-up their prepayment sub meters by purchasing a power code. Power codes are vended by
Metro Prepaid in thousands of high street stores in the UK via PaypPoint, as well as on-line, or via
bank payment, cash deposit or credit card (Paypal). A power code is a 20-digit encrypted number that
is punched into the meter by the tenant on returning home.

[ Buy Online ][31]

## Our Customer Stories

“ After setting up well over 1000 HMO rooms and many years as a property trainer, I know that the
all-in model with free electricity that many HMO owners adopt is flawed. It drives the wrong
behaviour, with tenants not switching off appliances using electric heaters whilst leaving the
windows wide open or worse taking a long weekend in Greece and leaving the appliances running. Savvy
landlords have been sub metering their tenants for years. ”
[READ MORE...][32]

Jim Haliburton - HMO Daddy

## Our Customer Stories

“ We recently spoke regarding our EV installation at 51, Haven Road, Poole. Since we spoke I have
had reason to speak to your help desk on several occasions seeking information. I wish to tell you
that each and every one of your staff that I have dealt with during these calls have had a total
understanding of the product, answered all of my questions, were efficient, helpful and are a total
credit to your company. It is a long time since I have received such excellent customer service. ”

Edward Fuller

## Customer service like customer service should be

“ I rang up a couple of weeks ago and spoke with Faseegah. Had some trouble with purchasing a
voucher and she was fantastic. Extremely helpful and clear in resolving the issue at hand with
minimum fuss. It is my first time using metro electric and I can safely say it’s been a breeze.
Definitely recommend to anyone interested in using metro. Faseegah of course is a huge asset to your
customer service team. Thank you for your prompt assistance. ”

Mr A Khan

## Metro Prepaid Helped Me

“ Joseph Rebutla, answered the 24 help line in less than ten seconds, was so calm thoughtful helpful
and shows his training was well worth it, what a gentleman. Very efficiently with zero fuss Joseph
guided me to full emergency electricity via the hitherto unseen unknown meter in my rented
accommodation. Heroic and generous with his time, polite and supportive he has made me a fan of
Metro Prepaid. As a modern solution to landlords seeking to isolate prepaid electricity supply to
multiple rooms or offices within a property, this system is ace for tenants and landlords. ”

Mark Anthony Ward @ Harmony & Riley Bioscape Inc.

## 5-star review

“ I was amazed at the excellent customer service displayed by your team. From prompt replies to easy
to speak to agents, I got my issue sorted out quickly and easily. Shout out to Lameck - an excellent
agent! ”

NWB Homes Ltd

“ Having just moved into a new rental and having no idea how to use the prepaid card, especially
after I'd left it to the last minute before figuring out how to top up, Zainu has helped me out
immensely. ”

veto a bipartisan reform effort supported by the General Assembly in favor of the utility’s agenda.

oversight, and guaranteed rate relief framework for Ohio renters. In addition, we encourage the PUCO
to fully implement the legislative intent. Doing so is essential to ensure that renters receive
meaningful protection, enforcement, and sustained reductions in their electric bills beyond AEP’s
escalating rate hikes.

# NEP’s HB 173 Statement

# House Bill 173 establishes the strongest consumer protection framework ever enacted for Ohio
# residents living in submetered communities.

framework ever enacted for Ohio residents living in submetered communities.

transparent rulemaking process subject to legislative oversight through JCARR.

regarding the regulatory framework governing submetering in Ohio. House Bill 173 provides the
comprehensive solution the Court envisioned by establishing clear rules, consistent oversight, and
meaningful consumer protections for residents across the state.

#### across Türkiye, Europe, and the United States.

We are an infrastructure development and engineering firm headquartered in Türkiye and the United
States. We work across the full lifecycle of renewable power plants, battery energy storage systems,
transmission and substation assets, and large-scale data centers. Our team brings together licensed
engineers, project developers, procurement specialists, construction managers, and commercial
advisors under one roof, with operating experience across utility-scale solar, wind, BESS, and
high-voltage transmission.

feasibility through construction and commissioning, and we structure every engagement so that one
team owns the technical, commercial, and execution risk.

  side, we identify and qualify sites against power availability, fiber connectivity, water
  resources, latency, and jurisdictional incentives, and carry projects through entitlement, design,
  and capital partner introductions.

* Procurement and Equipment Supply
  
  ODN Energy operates a procurement function that ranges from supplying a single transformer to
  running a full multi-package competitive tender. We support clients with item-level procurement,
  end-to-end purchasing management, tender administration, and consolidated bulk purchasing where
  scale produces meaningful pricing advantage.
  
  Through long-standing partnerships with manufacturers in Europe and Asia, we supply power and
  distribution transformers, dry-type and data center transformers, battery energy storage systems
  (BESS), PV modules, e-houses, mobile substations, modular data center solutions, LV and MCC
  panels, data center cabinets, medium- and low-voltage electrical equipment, power and
  communication cables, transmission towers and conductors, and high-pressure fogging and
  evaporative cooling systems. Every package is delivered with factory documentation, traceability
  records, warranty coverage, and local commissioning assistance.
* Installation and Construction
  
  ODN Energy self-performs and manages the construction of the assets it engineers and procures,
  closing the gap between design intent and a commissioned plant. We deliver installation and
  construction for utility-scale solar (SPP) and wind plants, battery energy storage systems,
  high-voltage substations, industrial facilities, and data centers either as a full EPC scope or as
  a balance-of-plant and electrical installation contractor working alongside the owner's other
  trades.
  
  The scope covers civil and structural works, mechanical and electrical (M&E) installation,
  mounting structures and module installation, BESS and e-house placement, MV/LV cabling and
  terminations, substation erection, transformer and switchgear installation, grounding and
  lightning protection, testing, energization, and commissioning. Each site is run by ODN Energy
  site managers and licensed engineers against a single HSE and quality plan, with progress, cost,
  and schedule reported to the client and lenders on one cadence.
  
  Because the same firm engineers, procures, and builds, design changes are absorbed internally
  rather than turned into contractual claims which is what keeps schedule and budget predictable
  from groundbreaking to energization.
* Owner's Engineering and Project Management
  
  For clients who are developing or financing projects but do not want to staff a full technical
  team, ODN Energy serves as the owner's engineer across power plants, data centers, energy storage
  systems, substations, and transmission lines. The role covers technology selection, design review,
  EPC contract structuring and tender management advisory, third-party Factory Acceptance Testing
  (FAT), construction supervision, and commissioning oversight.
  
  We also run full project management mandates where ODN Energy holds the program plan, manages the
  contractor interfaces, controls cost and schedule, and reports to the client and lenders. This is
  the engagement model investors and corporate owners use when they need execution accountability
  without taking on the staffing burden of an in-house EPC team.
* Strategic Advisory: Market Entry and M&A
  
  As clients expand into new geographies, ODN Energy provides business development advisory for
  entry into Middle East, Africa, European, and American renewable energy markets. The work covers
  regulatory and grid environment assessment, partner and counterparty mapping, route-to-market
  design, local entity structuring, and the first wave of project origination on the ground.
  
  We also advise on mergers and acquisitions for renewable energy projects, supporting buy-side and
  sell-side mandates through technical due diligence, commercial valuation, equipment and EPC
  quality assessment, and post-acquisition integration planning. Our M&A work is grounded in
  operational engineering experience, which is what allows us to surface the technical risks pure
  financial advisors typically miss.

### **Products**

ODN Energy supplies the core equipment classes behind power plants, energy storage, transmission &
distribution, and data center infrastructure sourced directly from certified manufacturers in the
U.S., Europe and Asia, delivered with full factory documentation, and backed by on-site
commissioning support. Every product line below can be procured as a single item or integrated into
a turnkey ODN Energy scope.

[Two large white shipping containers on flatbed trucks parked on a paved road near a grassy field
and a playground area.]

**E-House**

ODN Energy supplies prefabricated E-House (Electrical House) solutions for rapid and reliable
electrical infrastructure deployment at project sites. These self-contained, factory-assembled
structures house medium-voltage/low-voltage switchgear, transformers, and control and automation
equipment within a single insulated enclosure significantly reducing on-site installation time for
power plants, data centers, and industrial facilities.

Fully equipped at the factory and designed for plug-and-play commissioning upon delivery, E-Houses
are engineered for both indoor and outdoor applications. ODN Energy manages the full supply and
installation coordination of customized E-House solutions tailored to each project's voltage level,
capacity requirements, and environmental conditions.

[ODN_Mobile_Substation]

**Mobile Substation**

Mobile substations are fully equipped, road-transportable electrical systems designed for rapid
power infrastructure deployment in emergency situations, temporary connection points, or remote
project sites. They consolidate high- and medium-voltage components, transformers, and protection
equipment onto a single trailer or skid platform.

ODN Energy supplies and deploys mobile substations to ensure uninterrupted power supply during the
construction phase of new sites or to provide temporary feeding during maintenance windows on
existing systems. Available in a wide range of voltage levels and power capacities, each unit is
configured to match specific project and grid requirements.

[Electrical transformers and equipment installed outdoors on a power substation with a clear blue
sky in the background.]

**Transformers**

**Power transformers** perform voltage conversion between high-voltage transmission lines and
distribution networks, used in large-scale power plant grid connections, transmission projects, and
substations. Available from 5 MVA to 250 MVA across voltage levels from 72.5 kV up to 420 kV, with
on-load tap changer (OLTC) options and ONAN/ONAF oil cooling.

**Dry-type (cast resin) transformers** use air instead of oil as the cooling and insulation medium,
making them maintenance-free and significantly safer in fire terms than oil-immersed alternatives.
They are the preferred solution for indoor installations, densely populated areas, data centers, and
multi-story buildings, available from 25 kVA to 25,000 kVA up to 36 kV.

**Fogging System**

ODN Energy supplies and integrates high-pressure inlet fogging systems for gas turbines, used to
recover the output and efficiency that turbines lose as ambient temperature rises. Fine atomized
water injected into the inlet air stream evaporates and cools the air, increasing air density and
restoring or, with wet compression, augmenting turbine power output. The systems are OEM-compatible
and suited to both simple- and combined-cycle plants and peaking operation.
