#### ODN Energy develops, designs, builds, and delivers power plant and data center infrastructure
#### across Türkiye, Europe, and the United States.

We are an infrastructure development and engineering firm headquartered in Türkiye and the United
States. We work across the full lifecycle of renewable power plants, battery energy storage systems,
transmission and substation assets, and large-scale data centers. Our team brings together licensed
engineers, project developers, procurement specialists, construction managers, and commercial
advisors under one roof, with operating experience across utility-scale solar, wind, BESS, and
high-voltage transmission.

We are not a consultancy that walks away at the engineering deliverable. We carry projects from
feasibility through construction and commissioning, and we structure every engagement so that one
team owns the technical, commercial, and execution risk.

### **Services**

ODN Energy operates across the full project lifecycle for power plants, energy storage,
transmission, and data center infrastructure. Our services are structured so that clients can engage
us at any stage from a single piece of equipment to a full turnkey program and scale the
relationship as the project moves forward.
* Project Development
  
  We develop utility-scale renewable energy projects and data center campuses in Türkiye, Europe,
  and the United States. On the renewable side, this covers solar PV, onshore wind, and battery
  energy storage, from greenfield site identification through interconnection studies, permitting,
  environmental and social due diligence, PPA structuring, and financial close. On the data center
  side, we identify and qualify sites against power availability, fiber connectivity, water
  resources, latency, and jurisdictional incentives, and carry projects through entitlement, design,
  and capital partner introductions.
  
  We invest in projects at risk, partner with strategic and financial co-developers, and exit at
  points that match the client's hold strategy. Whether a project is sold at notice-to-proceed,
  taken to commercial operation, or held long-term, the development workstream is built to be
  bankable from day one.
  
  We invest in projects at risk, partner with strategic and financial co-developers, and exit at
  points that match the client's hold strategy. Whether a project is sold at notice-to-proceed,
  taken to commercial operation, or held long-term, the development workstream is built to be
  bankable from day one.
* Engineering and Design
  
  Our engineering practice covers concept design and detailed engineering for power plants, data
  centers, battery energy storage systems, substations, and energy transmission lines. Deliverables
  include feasibility studies, basic engineering packages, IFC drawings, electrical and civil detail
  design, single-line diagrams, protection coordination studies, grounding and lightning protection,
  and full bills of material ready for procurement.
  
  Every engineering output is produced by licensed engineers and signed off against the applicable
  national code whether that is the Turkish Electricity Distribution Regulation, IEC standards
  across the EU, or NEC, ANSI, and IEEE requirements in the United States. We routinely operate in
  jurisdictions that require dual or triple compliance, and our documentation is built to survive
  lender technical advisor review without rework.
  
  Every engineering output is produced by licensed engineers and signed off against the applicable
  national code, whether that is the Turkish Electricity Distribution Regulation, IEC standards
  across the EU, or NEC, ANSI, and IEEE requirements in the United States. We routinely operate in
  jurisdictions that require dual or triple compliance, and our documentation is built to survive
  lender technical advisor review without rework.
* Procurement and Equipment Supply
  
  ODN Energy operates a procurement function that ranges from supplying a single transformer to
  running a full multi-package competitive tender. We support clients with item-level procurement,
  end-to-end purchasing management, tender administration, and consolidated bulk purchasing where
  scale produces meaningful pricing advantage.
  
  Through long-standing partnerships with manufacturers in Europe and Asia, we supply power and
  distribution transformers, dry-type and data center transformers, battery energy storage systems
  (BESS), PV modules, e-houses, mobile substations, modular data center solutions, LV and MCC
  panels, data center cabinets, medium- and low-voltage electrical equipment, power and
  communication cables, transmission towers and conductors, and high-pressure fogging and
  evaporative cooling systems. Every package is delivered with factory documentation, traceability
  records, warranty coverage, and local commissioning assistance.
* Installation and Construction
  
  ODN Energy self-performs and manages the construction of the assets it engineers and procures,
  closing the gap between design intent and a commissioned plant. We deliver installation and
  construction for utility-scale solar (SPP) and wind plants, battery energy storage systems,
  high-voltage substations, industrial facilities, and data centers either as a full EPC scope or as
  a balance-of-plant and electrical installation contractor working alongside the owner's other
  trades.
  
  The scope covers civil and structural works, mechanical and electrical (M&E) installation,
  mounting structures and module installation, BESS and e-house placement, MV/LV cabling and
  terminations, substation erection, transformer and switchgear installation, grounding and
  lightning protection, testing, energization, and commissioning. Each site is run by ODN Energy
  site managers and licensed engineers against a single HSE and quality plan, with progress, cost,
  and schedule reported to the client and lenders on one cadence.
  
  Because the same firm engineers, procures, and builds, design changes are absorbed internally
  rather than turned into contractual claims which is what keeps schedule and budget predictable
  from groundbreaking to energization.
* Owner's Engineering and Project Management
  
  For clients who are developing or financing projects but do not want to staff a full technical
  team, ODN Energy serves as the owner's engineer across power plants, data centers, energy storage
  systems, substations, and transmission lines. The role covers technology selection, design review,
  EPC contract structuring and tender management advisory, third-party Factory Acceptance Testing
  (FAT), construction supervision, and commissioning oversight.
  
  We also run full project management mandates where ODN Energy holds the program plan, manages the
  contractor interfaces, controls cost and schedule, and reports to the client and lenders. This is
  the engagement model investors and corporate owners use when they need execution accountability
  without taking on the staffing burden of an in-house EPC team.
* Strategic Advisory: Market Entry and M&A
  
  As clients expand into new geographies, ODN Energy provides business development advisory for
  entry into Middle East, Africa, European, and American renewable energy markets. The work covers
  regulatory and grid environment assessment, partner and counterparty mapping, route-to-market
  design, local entity structuring, and the first wave of project origination on the ground.
  
  We also advise on mergers and acquisitions for renewable energy projects, supporting buy-side and
  sell-side mandates through technical due diligence, commercial valuation, equipment and EPC
  quality assessment, and post-acquisition integration planning. Our M&A work is grounded in
  operational engineering experience, which is what allows us to surface the technical risks pure
  financial advisors typically miss.

### **Products**

ODN Energy supplies the core equipment classes behind power plants, energy storage, transmission &
distribution, and data center infrastructure sourced directly from certified manufacturers in the
U.S., Europe and Asia, delivered with full factory documentation, and backed by on-site
commissioning support. Every product line below can be procured as a single item or integrated into
a turnkey ODN Energy scope.

[Two large white shipping containers on flatbed trucks parked on a paved road near a grassy field
and a playground area.]

**E-House**

ODN Energy supplies prefabricated E-House (Electrical House) solutions for rapid and reliable
electrical infrastructure deployment at project sites. These self-contained, factory-assembled
structures house medium-voltage/low-voltage switchgear, transformers, and control and automation
equipment within a single insulated enclosure significantly reducing on-site installation time for
power plants, data centers, and industrial facilities.

Fully equipped at the factory and designed for plug-and-play commissioning upon delivery, E-Houses
are engineered for both indoor and outdoor applications. ODN Energy manages the full supply and
installation coordination of customized E-House solutions tailored to each project's voltage level,
capacity requirements, and environmental conditions.

[ODN_Mobile_Substation]

**Mobile Substation**

Mobile substations are fully equipped, road-transportable electrical systems designed for rapid
power infrastructure deployment in emergency situations, temporary connection points, or remote
project sites. They consolidate high- and medium-voltage components, transformers, and protection
equipment onto a single trailer or skid platform.

ODN Energy supplies and deploys mobile substations to ensure uninterrupted power supply during the
construction phase of new sites or to provide temporary feeding during maintenance windows on
existing systems. Available in a wide range of voltage levels and power capacities, each unit is
configured to match specific project and grid requirements.

[Electrical transformers and equipment installed outdoors on a power substation with a clear blue
sky in the background.]

**Transformers**

**Power transformers** perform voltage conversion between high-voltage transmission lines and
distribution networks, used in large-scale power plant grid connections, transmission projects, and
substations. Available from 5 MVA to 250 MVA across voltage levels from 72.5 kV up to 420 kV, with
on-load tap changer (OLTC) options and ONAN/ONAF oil cooling.

**Dry-type (cast resin) transformers** use air instead of oil as the cooling and insulation medium,
making them maintenance-free and significantly safer in fire terms than oil-immersed alternatives.
They are the preferred solution for indoor installations, densely populated areas, data centers, and
multi-story buildings, available from 25 kVA to 25,000 kVA up to 36 kV.

**Fogging System**

ODN Energy supplies and integrates high-pressure inlet fogging systems for gas turbines, used to
recover the output and efficiency that turbines lose as ambient temperature rises. Fine atomized
water injected into the inlet air stream evaporates and cools the air, increasing air density and
restoring or, with wet compression, augmenting turbine power output. The systems are OEM-compatible
and suited to both simple- and combined-cycle plants and peaking operation.

# Intelligent, automated energy management solutions for your business

We offer automated, zero-human-input energy management solutions, sub-metering, and consultancy
services designed to help businesses of all sizes slash energy costs and dramatically reduce carbon
emissions.

Whether you operate multiple small sites or manage complex large sites, our automated software
platform can unlock significant savings. EMMA AI works tirelessly 24/7, requiring no human
intervention, no complex data management, and absolutely no constant parameter adjustments.

[GET IN TOUCH][7]
[Learn more about intelligent energy management solutions with our latest blog posts]
[Automated energy management - A flowchart for emmaAI showing three steps: connect your energy data
(light bulb icon), connect all your energy platforms (cog and building icon), and add sub-metering
services (gauge icon).]

## Start with zero capital expenditure

### 1) Connect your energy data

To begin, we’ll connect your existing energy metering data to the EMMA AI platform. This then
analyses your usage across all your sites from day one, generating immediate, actionable savings
across your business.

### 2) Add sub-metering services

Once you are up and running, we can then look to increase the energy savings you make through the
addition of sub-metering.

### 3) Connect all your energy management platforms

For our larger clients, we can additionally integrate data from 3rd -party energy management
systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), EV charging data, solar and much more.

[Automated energy management - A thick, curved yellow arrow points downward and to the right on a
white background.]
[Automated energy management - Grey icon of a microchip with the letters AI in the centre,
representing artificial intelligence technology. The microchip has symmetrical pins extending
outward on all four sides.]

## Connect your data and start saving with

[Automated energy management - Logo with the text emma AI in black and yellow, and powered by
Optimal monitoring in grey and yellow below.]
EMMA AI is our intelligent monitoring system designed for businesses with multiple locations. In
just a couple of hours, EMMA AI connects to your existing energy data and commences the tracking of
energy usage across all your sites every 30 minutes. Analysis of this half-hour data allows the
platform to learn about your business and identify where gas and electricity are being wasted.

Together with allowing you to see potential savings at a business-wide level, importantly, your site
managers receive a simple email telling them where energy was wasted over the last 24 hours and how
to prevent it from happening again. This simple step leads to immediate actionable savings, as your
staff become an army of energy managers, changing habits and saving you money and CO2 emissions
every single day!

EMMA AI is saving our customers millions every single year … all with zero up-front capital
expenditure!

## Sub-metering services

[Automated energy management - A close-up image of a watt-hour meter with three labelled points:
Installation, Data integration, and Maintenance, each connected to the meter with lines. The meter
displays the number 0582.]

For energy managers overseeing large estates, understanding energy consumption at a granular level
is critical. This is where submetering becomes invaluable. Installing additional meters beyond the
main utility meter allows you to track energy consumption by specific areas, departments, or even
individual pieces of equipment.

This provides detailed visibility into exactly where and how energy is being used, empowering EMMA
AI with more data to deliver even greater savings.

[Explore our sub-metering services][9]

## Connect all your energy platforms

[Automated energy management - A digital illustration of a modern hospital building is shown with
four labelled lines pointing to it: Utilities, HVAC/air quality, Lighting, and EV charging. The
building has multiple floors and an emergency sign.]

Large organisations often utilise a diverse array of platforms to manage their energy, from
traditional Building Management Systems (BMS) handling utilities, heating, and lighting, to
cutting-edge solar and EV charging management systems.

By seamlessly integrating these platforms with EMMA AI, you unlock the potential for even greater
energy savings, enabling you to analyse complex issues, drastically reduce energy waste, and
streamline maintenance operations—all managed from a single, unified platform.

## **Flexible Utility Billing Solutions for Communities with Utility Submeters**

Recovering utility costs is one of the most critical components of effectively managing multifamily
and commercial properties. At Oates Energy, we specialize in utility billing and submetering
solutions that are fully customizable to the unique needs of each community and property we support.
With decades of experience and a wide client base, we understand that no two properties are the
same, which is why our billing systems are never one-size-fits-all.

We serve a diverse range of submetered communities by offering flexible billing options for water,
electricity, and gas that align with your property’s layout, tenant profile, and management goals.
Our accurate, timely billing processes help property managers improve utility cost recovery while
enhancing transparency for residents. Discover why hundreds of communities trust Oates Energy as
their utility billing and submetering partner.

[**Find out why so many property managers choose Oates Energy >>**][95]

## **RUBS Billing Solutions for Communities without Utility Submeters**

# Smart Meters

## What is SmartMe?

SmartMe is an independent UK website explaining how electricity and gas smart meters work.

The site provides clear technical explanations of the UK smart meter system, including how smart
meters communicate, the differences between SMETS1 and SMETS2 meters, and how consumers can monitor
and understand their energy usage.

SmartMe was created by engineers with experience in smart meter technology and energy systems. The
goal of the site is to provide accurate, easy-to-understand information about smart meters, how they
operate, and how they affect households across the United Kingdom.

Topics covered on SmartMe include:
* How smart meters work
* SMETS1 vs SMETS2 meters
* Smart meter communications networks
* Home Area Networks and In-Home Displays
* The UK smart meter rollout
* Common smart meter questions and problems.

## The truth about Smart Meters - the good and the bad

[Simple diagram showing how meters and IHD connect.]

Energy supply companies have been installing smart meters for electricity and gas in homes across
Great Britain since 2012. By 2025, all residential and small businesses across England, Scotland and
Wales will be offered a smart meter by their energy supplier.

In Northern Ireland the Department for the Economy (DfE) has recommended an electricity smart meter
roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.
  * **IHD not working** - Many customers call the In Home Device that usually sits on the worktop in
    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.

roll-out over six years starting in 2027. A gas roll-out won't be included as the benefits were not
sufficient.

A smart meter sends an electronic meter reading to your energy supplier, meaning:
* they won't need to take a manual meter reading - as the meters send back readings themselves
* you won't get estimated bills - as actual readings are available
* it'll be easier to switch energy suppliers - as the reading at changeover is readily available
* there should be less arguments - as the readings are reliable and not subject to disagreement.

You'll also get a digital display in your home, helping you to keep track of how much energy you're
using and how much it's costing.

You won't have to pay for your smart meter or digital display up front - the cost will be included
in everyone's energy bill over the next few years.

A smart meter won't change how you currently pay for your energy bill, e.g. monthly, or prepaid.
This will still be determined by the product and payment method you choose.

Smart Meters and their roll-out haven't been perfect and they've been the subject of negative
headlines. What do these headlines really mean?
* **Smart Meters don't work** - this headline has covered different problems over time, so let's
  break it down into the different reasons:
  * **Incorrect Bills** - When the Smart Meters fail to send in readings suppliers use estimates.
    This can go on for a while and can sometimes result in an unexpectedly large bill when a reading
    finally gets through.
    The meters are still recording accurately so customers just need to check their bill is not
    using estimates and send in a [manual reading][36] if necessary. If you do not want to check
    your bill just send in a meter reading every month as you would with a traditional meter.
  * **IHD not working** - Many customers call the In Home Device that usually sits on the worktop in
    their kitchen their “meter”. So, when that doesn't work they complain their meter is not
    working. Their meter is working and recording energy accurately but, frustratingly, they cannot
    see that on the IHD. They have to go to their meter to [read][37] their consumption.
    Solutions to the IHD being too far away from the Comms Hub are being investigated by the [Alt
    HAN Co Ltd][38].
  * **No communications** - Communication with the meters is essential to set up tariffs and
    prepayment mode. Without communications your meter will operate as a traditional one rate meter,
    and you'll have to take your own readings. Understandably customers get very frustrated when
    their meters can't communicate and yet they have a good mobile signal and a good broadband
    connection. Progress to find alternative solutions for the [Wide Area Network (WAN)][39] have
    been slow which is again frustrating as the barriers to a solution are not technical but
    political.
  * **Stops working after changing supplier** - Older [SMETS 1][40] meters operated on many
    different management systems and could not always be supported when a customer changed supplier
    as the systems tended to be supplier specific. [SMETS 2][41] meters do not have this problem as
    a common system is used operated by the Data Communications Company (DCC).
* **North South Divide** - As the characteristics of the North and South of the country are
  different, a different communications system was setup for the two areas. Each system has pros and
  cons but sensibly a longer-range radio system was used in the North. However, customers in the
  North can get frustrated when they have a perfectly good mobile phone signal and the Long Range
  Radio signal to their meter is too weak for communication to work successfully. This has now been
  addressed as mobile 4G communications can be used in Scotland and the North of England from
  30^{th} May 2025.
  So, one could now argue that the North has better communications options than the South. See more
  information on our [SMETS 2][42] page.

Many people have questions about Smart Meters, this website tries to answer them honestly for
electricity and gas meters, thoroughly and without bias. This site does not deal with Smart water
meters as our team do not have expertise in that area.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What is SolarSquare?

SolarSquare designs and installs solar panel systems for homes, housing societies and businesses.

With a relentless commitment to innovation and excellence, we’re driving the Har Ghar Solar mission
forward, one rooftop at a time.

Established in 2015 by a passionate trio of solar enthusiasts — Shreya Mishra, Neeraj Jain, and
Nikhil Nahar — SolarSquare is India’s most trusted residential solar company. We believe in the
power of solar to not only reduce carbon footprints but also to revolutionise the way we power our
homes and businesses.

## What is a solar rooftop system?

A solar rooftop system is a combination of many components that convert sunlight into usable
electricity.

The components of a rooftop solar include the following –
* Solar panels with PV cells
* Solar inverter
* Solar panel mounting structures
* AC and DC cables
* AC combiner box
* DC combiner box
* Earthing cables
* MC4 connectors

## How does a solar rooftop system work?

A solar rooftop system works on the concept of conversion of sunlight into electricity. The
phenomenon is known as the photovoltaic effect.

When sunlight falls on the PV cells in a solar panel, the sunlight is converted into electricity.
The generated power is DC current. An AC combiner box is used to convert that DC power into usable
AC power.

The generated AC electricity is fed into a bidirectional meter that supplies power to the house. It
also exports excess power to the DISCOM (grid) and imports power from the grid if electricity
generated by the rooftop solar system is not enough to cover the daily requirement.

## Why should I switch to solar?

If you are dealing with high electricity bills, tapping into solar power is your best way to bring
them down. Apart from the rising cost of electricity, solar power also helps you reduce dependency
on the grid and reduce your carbon footprint.

## Is solar power safe?

**Yes**. The electricity produced by a solar power system is no different than the electricity you
get from your electricity distribution company. The only difference is the source. Moreover, it is
among the safest source of electricity consumption because it is neither hazardous nor does it
release any toxic or harmful gases during production.

## How high does my electricity bill need to be for solar to make sense for me?

We offer solar solutions for homes of all sizes. However, we’ve found that the overall investment
into a solar system works out best economically for homes with electricity bills starting at ₹1,500.

## How do I decide what size of plant I need?

The size of your Solar plant depends on the following factors
* Your electricity consumption pattern
* Available shadow free area
* Solar irradiation in your area

Once you enlist your interest in a solar project, SolarSquare conducts a scientific mapping of the
appropriate project size for you.

## How much can I actually save with solar?

Most homeowners cut their electricity bills by 80–90% from Day 1. And with rising tariffs, your
savings only keep growing every year.

## What makes SolarSquare different from other solar providers?

We handle everything for you end-to-end: design, installation, subsidy paperwork, financing, and
even offer you 5-year free maintenance. We are a no middlemen service. We are also India’s only
solar company to offer Guaranteed Savings with a money-back promise.

## I’m not sure if I have enough space for a solar system.

Not to worry. Once you share your details with us, you get a free home visit from our solar
consultant who will evaluate your space and power needs and give you a free personalised 3D rooftop
solar design for your home. You only need to proceed if you are happy with the offered solution.

## Do I need to pay a huge amount upfront?

No. With flexible EMIs starting low, you can go solar without any initial investment. The government
subsidy pays for your down payment and bill savings often cover the EMI.

## How complicated is the solar subsidy process?

We understand you may be apprehensive about the paperwork, but we manage the whole thing for you.
You won’t have to lift a finger.

## How long does it take to set up the solar system?

Once we have visited your home and you’ve approved the 3D rooftop solar design, the installation is
done in 1 day – based on your availability, the space and weather conditions.

## What is the lifespan of a rooftop solar system?

A high-quality rooftop solar system lasts 25 years or more. The panels keep generating clean power
for decades, and with SolarSquare’s 5-year free maintenance and performance checks, your system
stays in top shape throughout its life.

## Do solar panels alone guarantee long-term savings?

Panels are only one part of the system. Besides the quality of your solar panels, your long-term
savings depend on system design, strong mounting structure, and regular maintenance. If any of these
are weak, your power generation (and savings) from rooftop solar will drop over time.
With SolarSquare’s professionally engineered system and regular maintenance, you’ll enjoy
consistent, high savings for 25+ years.

## How will I know how much power my system is generating?

We have an app that’s connected to your system, where you can monitor your power generation in real
time and get 100% visibility on your savings.

## What do I need to install a rooftop solar system?

All you need to qualify for a solar system is – empty space on your roof and access to your rooftop.
Just fill the project enquiry form on our website and our team will contact you to discuss your
requirement. Once the project is finalised, we will take care of your entire plant design,
installation and maintenance.

## What are the different types of Solar systems?

There are 3 types of Solar systems depending on whether the plant is linked to the power grid or
battery systems for storage.
* On-grid solar systems use common solar inverters and are connected to the public electricity grid.
  Any excess solar power that you generate is exported to the electricity grid and one usually get
  paid a feed-in-tariff or credits for the energy you export. The policy for getting credits for
  energy exported to the credit is termed as “Net-Metering Policy” and is available currently in
  most states of India.
* Off-grid solar systems are not connected to the electricity grid and therefore requires battery
  storage. An off-grid solar system must be designed appropriately so that it will generate enough
  power throughout the year and have enough battery capacity to meet the home’s requirements, even
  in the depths of winter when there is less sunlight.
* Hybrid solar systems combines solar and battery storage in one and are now available in many
  different forms and configurations. This means being able to store solar energy that is generated
  during the day and using it at night. When the stored energy is depleted, the grid is there as
  backup, allowing consumers to have the best of both worlds.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* All your questions, answered.

## What is SolarSquare?

SolarSquare designs and installs solar panel systems for homes, housing societies and businesses.

With a relentless commitment to innovation and excellence, we’re driving the Har Ghar Solar mission
forward, one rooftop at a time.

Established in 2015 by a passionate trio of solar enthusiasts — Shreya Mishra, Neeraj Jain, and
Nikhil Nahar — SolarSquare is India’s most trusted residential solar company. We believe in the
power of solar to not only reduce carbon footprints but also to revolutionise the way we power our
homes and businesses.

## What is a solar rooftop system?

A solar rooftop system is a combination of many components that convert sunlight into usable
electricity.

The components of a rooftop solar include the following –
* Solar panels with PV cells
* Solar inverter
* Solar panel mounting structures
* AC and DC cables
* AC combiner box
* DC combiner box
* Earthing cables
* MC4 connectors

## How does a solar rooftop system work?

A solar rooftop system works on the concept of conversion of sunlight into electricity. The
phenomenon is known as the photovoltaic effect.

When sunlight falls on the PV cells in a solar panel, the sunlight is converted into electricity.
The generated power is DC current. An AC combiner box is used to convert that DC power into usable
AC power.

The generated AC electricity is fed into a bidirectional meter that supplies power to the house. It
also exports excess power to the DISCOM (grid) and imports power from the grid if electricity
generated by the rooftop solar system is not enough to cover the daily requirement.

## Why should I switch to solar?

If you are dealing with high electricity bills, tapping into solar power is your best way to bring
them down. Apart from the rising cost of electricity, solar power also helps you reduce dependency
on the grid and reduce your carbon footprint.

## Is solar power safe?

**Yes**. The electricity produced by a solar power system is no different than the electricity you
get from your electricity distribution company. The only difference is the source. Moreover, it is
among the safest source of electricity consumption because it is neither hazardous nor does it
release any toxic or harmful gases during production.

## How high does my electricity bill need to be for solar to make sense for me?

We offer solar solutions for homes of all sizes. However, we’ve found that the overall investment
into a solar system works out best economically for homes with electricity bills starting at ₹1,500.

## How do I decide what size of plant I need?

The size of your Solar plant depends on the following factors
* Your electricity consumption pattern
* Available shadow free area
* Solar irradiation in your area

Once you enlist your interest in a solar project, SolarSquare conducts a scientific mapping of the
appropriate project size for you.

## How much can I actually save with solar?

Most homeowners cut their electricity bills by 80–90% from Day 1. And with rising tariffs, your
savings only keep growing every year.

## What makes SolarSquare different from other solar providers?

We handle everything for you end-to-end: design, installation, subsidy paperwork, financing, and
even offer you 5-year free maintenance. We are a no middlemen service. We are also India’s only
solar company to offer Guaranteed Savings with a money-back promise.

## I’m not sure if I have enough space for a solar system.

Not to worry. Once you share your details with us, you get a free home visit from our solar
consultant who will evaluate your space and power needs and give you a free personalised 3D rooftop
solar design for your home. You only need to proceed if you are happy with the offered solution.

## Do I need to pay a huge amount upfront?

No. With flexible EMIs starting low, you can go solar without any initial investment. The government
subsidy pays for your down payment and bill savings often cover the EMI.

## How complicated is the solar subsidy process?

We understand you may be apprehensive about the paperwork, but we manage the whole thing for you.
You won’t have to lift a finger.

## How long does it take to set up the solar system?

Once we have visited your home and you’ve approved the 3D rooftop solar design, the installation is
done in 1 day – based on your availability, the space and weather conditions.

## What is the lifespan of a rooftop solar system?

A high-quality rooftop solar system lasts 25 years or more. The panels keep generating clean power
for decades, and with SolarSquare’s 5-year free maintenance and performance checks, your system
stays in top shape throughout its life.

## Do solar panels alone guarantee long-term savings?

Panels are only one part of the system. Besides the quality of your solar panels, your long-term
savings depend on system design, strong mounting structure, and regular maintenance. If any of these
are weak, your power generation (and savings) from rooftop solar will drop over time.
With SolarSquare’s professionally engineered system and regular maintenance, you’ll enjoy
consistent, high savings for 25+ years.

## How will I know how much power my system is generating?

We have an app that’s connected to your system, where you can monitor your power generation in real
time and get 100% visibility on your savings.

## What do I need to install a rooftop solar system?

All you need to qualify for a solar system is – empty space on your roof and access to your rooftop.
Just fill the project enquiry form on our website and our team will contact you to discuss your
requirement. Once the project is finalised, we will take care of your entire plant design,
installation and maintenance.

## What are the different types of Solar systems?

There are 3 types of Solar systems depending on whether the plant is linked to the power grid or
battery systems for storage.
* On-grid solar systems use common solar inverters and are connected to the public electricity grid.
  Any excess solar power that you generate is exported to the electricity grid and one usually get
  paid a feed-in-tariff or credits for the energy you export. The policy for getting credits for
  energy exported to the credit is termed as “Net-Metering Policy” and is available currently in
  most states of India.
* Off-grid solar systems are not connected to the electricity grid and therefore requires battery
  storage. An off-grid solar system must be designed appropriately so that it will generate enough
  power throughout the year and have enough battery capacity to meet the home’s requirements, even
  in the depths of winter when there is less sunlight.
* Hybrid solar systems combines solar and battery storage in one and are now available in many
  different forms and configurations. This means being able to store solar energy that is generated
  during the day and using it at night. When the stored energy is depleted, the grid is there as
  backup, allowing consumers to have the best of both worlds.

## Frequently Asked Questions

No matter which service utility you need, our experts are ready to help.

What is the cost of submetering?

The cost of submetering can vary based on several factors, including the type of submeter, the
number of units, and the complexity of installation. Costs are generally divided into two main
categories: the price of the submeter equipment itself and the installation fees. The overall
expense will depend on your specific setup and the utilities being submetered. It’s essential to
consider both equipment and installation costs when budgeting for submetering in your property. We’d
love to get you a specific proposal, [get started here][83].

Why should I consider submetering?

Submetering promotes fair and equitable distribution of utility costs, encouraging conservation and
reducing overall expenses.

How does submetering work?

Submeters are installed to measure individual unit consumption, and the data is used to calculate
each unit’s utility bill.

Who benefits from submetering?

Property owners, tenants, and the environment benefit from submetering through cost savings and
conservation efforts.

Are there any regulations or laws regarding submetering?

Yes, there are various state and local regulations that govern submetering. We ensure compliance
with all relevant laws.

What is the installation process for submeters?

We provide the equipment and work with your team to make sure everything is installed correctly to
maximize your property ROI.

How often are submeters read and bills generated?

Submeters are typically read monthly, and bills are generated accordingly.

What is Ratio Utility Billing System (RUBS), and do you offer it?

Ratio Utility Billing System, or RUBS, is a method of dividing utility costs among tenants based on
various factors like unit size, occupancy, or other allocated criteria. We do offer RUBS as an
alternative to submetering for properties that prefer this approach. It allows us to fairly
distribute utility costs among tenants even without individual submeters.

## Frequently Asked Questions

No matter which service utility you need, our experts are ready to help.

What is the cost of submetering?

The cost of submetering can vary based on several factors, including the type of submeter, the
number of units, and the complexity of installation. Costs are generally divided into two main
categories: the price of the submeter equipment itself and the installation fees. The overall
expense will depend on your specific setup and the utilities being submetered. It’s essential to
consider both equipment and installation costs when budgeting for submetering in your property. We’d
love to get you a specific proposal, [get started here][83].

Why should I consider submetering?

Submetering promotes fair and equitable distribution of utility costs, encouraging conservation and
reducing overall expenses.

How does submetering work?

Submeters are installed to measure individual unit consumption, and the data is used to calculate
each unit’s utility bill.

Who benefits from submetering?

Property owners, tenants, and the environment benefit from submetering through cost savings and
conservation efforts.

Are there any regulations or laws regarding submetering?

Yes, there are various state and local regulations that govern submetering. We ensure compliance
with all relevant laws.

What is the installation process for submeters?

We provide the equipment and work with your team to make sure everything is installed correctly to
maximize your property ROI.

How often are submeters read and bills generated?

Submeters are typically read monthly, and bills are generated accordingly.

What is Ratio Utility Billing System (RUBS), and do you offer it?

Ratio Utility Billing System, or RUBS, is a method of dividing utility costs among tenants based on
various factors like unit size, occupancy, or other allocated criteria. We do offer RUBS as an
alternative to submetering for properties that prefer this approach. It allows us to fairly
distribute utility costs among tenants even without individual submeters.

## 3-Phase Energy Meters for Industry

Tech OVN is a dedicated energy meter manufacturer building a 3-phase electronic energy meter range
for industrial sub-metering: DIN rail smart energy meters, WiFi energy meters, and cloud-connected
industrial energy meters — all designed and produced in-house. Our Titan meter is an industrial
energy meter with Class 0.5S accuracy per IEC 62053-22, built for factory and commercial
sub-metering where utility-grade data actually matters.

Whether you're specifying a 3 phase smart energy meter for a new factory, retrofitting a wifi energy
meter to an existing switchboard, or sourcing an IoT energy meter for a multi-site portfolio — the
[Titan 3 phase energy meter][9] covers all three with a single DIN rail SKU.

Energy Intelligence Platform

## See every kWh, across every site

Every Titan device streams to our cloud [Energy Management System][10] — live load, threshold
alarms, and predictive anomalies across every meter and asset in your portfolio, in one dashboard.

[Explore the platform →][11]
[Tech OVN Energy Intelligence Platform — asset fleet overview dashboard with vibration trends,
status table, and runtime anomalies]

## Certifications & Standards

Tech OVN meters are independently certified to international and Indian standards — from ISO quality
management to NABL-accredited calibration.

## Why Tech OVN

Engineering heritage meets modern intelligence.

### Since 1949

Built on the legacy of OVN Engineers — decades of precision engineering and energy expertise
powering our innovation today.

### Global Compliance

IEC type-test certified meters meeting international standards for accuracy, safety, and
electromagnetic compatibility.

### Cloud-Native Intelligence

The Energy Intelligence Platform transforms raw meter data into actionable insights with real-time
dashboards and AI analytics.

## Ready to monitor your energy?

Get in touch to learn how Tech OVN can transform your energy infrastructure with precision metering
and cloud intelligence.
